title: SWF static inspection output
description: Contract for the generated SWF inspection: per-path static inventories plus corpus statistics for conversion scoping. All data comes from static byte reads; nothing is executed or rendered.

result.description: Build outcome marker; only successful runs write outputs.

inputs.description: Input provenance: registry digest plus corpus file count.

counts.description: Corpus statistics: file count, version distribution, scripted-file counts, embedded-asset totals.

entries.description: Per-path inspection entries keyed by registry path.
